questions.content: When will the quarterly sales report be ready?

questions.script: When will the quarterly sales report be ready? — By Friday afternoon, I hope.

questions.content: The new marketing manager has a lot of experience in ______ advertising campaigns for international brands.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ "in" cần dạng V-ing nên chọn "creating".

options.content: The finance director is unable to attend.

options.label: B

Woman: How about 10 a.m. in the main conference room? Man: That sounds good. I'll send an email to the team right away.
